title: Is it a circle?
about: The smallest possible deck: images and one yes/no question.

title: Model A vs model B
about: Two models' masks on the same cells. Pick the right one, or say both are wrong.

title: Check a detector
about: Boxes with labels and scores, plus extra answer buttons.

title: Follow a track
about: Three frames per card: does the tracker stay on one cell?

title: Mask the fruit
about: No question: draw masks with classes (apple, orange, leaf). Shows the mask editor.

title: Fix the nuclei (16-bit)
about: Raw 16-bit microscopy, 2 channels, auto contrast. Fix a model's merged, split and missed nuclei.

title: Follow the cells
about: Manual tracking: tap the same cell frame after frame. One cell divides.

title: 2 channels over time
about: 16-bit time-lapse with 2 channels per frame (Mix, side by side), 2 models, 8 answers.
